name: zapsign-mcp-workflows
description: Reusable e-signature workflows powered by the ZapSign MCP server, with privacy-minimized allowlisted tool responses.

interface.longDescription: Create signing requests from files or templates, manage signer delivery, and track signature status with ZapSign. MCP responses use a field allowlist and omit government IDs, biometrics, geolocation, IP, certificates, and signing links on reads.
